about: An underground cavern adventure where I arrive after a dream told me to seek a wise man when worthy. I explored a junction, a shadowy land and an underground sea shore.

done.why: Short wander; the sailor would not talk, paths were blocked, and I had no clear goal.

moments.note: Moving into the dark gave a grue warning; lighting the lamp fixed it, nice.
Arthur joke when pulling the sword.
Said hello to nobody; footsteps heard but I could not find who.
Sailor passes by but I can't talk to or board the boat.

wished: Talk to the sailor or hail the boat
Find out who made the footsteps
Know what the final test is

lines.line: Who do you think you are? Arthur?
lines.why: Funny response to a natural try.

lines.line: You can hear quiet footsteps nearby.

fun.why: Charming bits but little to do.

engagement.why: Footsteps and boat hooked me briefly.

difficulty.why: Unclear goals, a few dead ends.

interestingness.why: Atmospheric setting with hints of others.

prose.why: Evocative descriptions of the sea and shadows.
